title: First Contact

reference.why: introspective/euphoric release with female-led chorus — the emotional arc target for the second drop. Dark/industrial side modeled on Burr Oak per vault vocal concept.

goal: First Contact as the EP opener: signal/static theme, male-female vocal trade-off, euphoric female-led chorus, hard-stop 22s-silence breakdown as the dramatic peak.
problem: Second chorus must land brighter/more energetic than the first without the arrangement feeling repetitive.
unique_idea: 22s of true digital silence at the breakdown (not a fade) before the near-a-cappella female line re-enters.
notes: Starter build sheet from vault First_Contact_Vocal_Concept.md + sketch structure (Em, ~174 BPM, 232s: intro→drop A→hard-stop breakdown→drop C→outro). Analysis pending analyze_track.py on FIRST CONTACT V4.wav.
